verdict.rationale: Reflect has a built-in AI palette (cmd+j on highlighted text) with prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items', an open text field for custom requests that can be saved as reusable prompts, and a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. After filtering search results by tags, dates, backlinks or pinned status, you can 'chat' with just those notes, so both Q&A and summarization are scoped to the notes you pick. missing for 10: explicit privacy controls for AI (what is sent to OpenAI/Anthropic and how that squares with end-to-end encryption, opt-out settings), clear documentation of long-form drafting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
